name: Vessel Local VPS Control Plane
free_limit: MIT-licensed desktop VPS management application for Windows, Linux and macOS; no software subscription, usage quota or expiry. Connects over SSH/SFTP to manage remote files, systemd services, Docker, Nginx/Caddy and server resources.
watch_out: Free software only: no VPS, compute, bandwidth or hosting is included. Requires an existing Linux server and SSH credentials; remote infrastructure and any third-party services may incur charges. Project is early-stage; validate security and compatibility before production use.
